episode_title: How an AI Army Replaced His Ad Agency (Up to $150K/Month in Spend)

real_qa.q: How did Airlock automate its Meta ad campaign management to eliminate the need for an external ad agency?
real_qa.r: Mariano built an AI-powered system using GrokBot agents connected via MCP integrations to Stefan Brain for copywriting, Higgsfield for B-roll video generation, and Adnova for creative management. The workflow runs entirely on Slack: designers upload creative files to a Slack channel, the Ad Launcher bot retrieves them, identifies issues, hands off to a bot that writes headlines and descriptions, passes through a 'boomer bot' quality control trained on customer feedback, and finally coordinates with a main media buyer bot named 'Suck' that decides campaign placement in Meta. This replaced their previous manual process where each individual ad required 20 clicks.
real_qa.requete: Airlock AI ad agency replacement automation

real_qa.q: What is Stefan Brain and how does it improve LLM-generated direct response ad copy?
real_qa.r: Stefan Brain is a custom LLM platform trained by direct response copywriter Stefan Georgi that generates significantly better ad copy than plain Claude or OpenAI. Unlike standard LLMs that try to close the loop and be overly smart, resulting in copy that feels like it came from an AI, Stefan Brain is specifically trained on what makes copy convert. When you input your products and brand information, the platform generates copy at a 'decent good level' that is much stronger than baseline LLM outputs, solving the problem Mariano's team had when trying to train their own systems on copywriting principles.
real_qa.requete: Stefan Brain direct response copywriting platform

real_qa.q: How does Airlock use Higgsfield to generate B-roll video content for product ads?
real_qa.r: Higgsfield generates AI video of Airlock products inside boats and RVs without needing to physically locate real boats, get permission, and film on location. For example, three to four years ago Mariano would need to find a boat in Fort Lauderdale, get permission to enter, place their products, and record footage. Now Higgsfield can generate video of their products in the exact boat or RV they want under exact conditions, producing excellent quality video. Mariano feeds reference images to models like Kling (cheaper than Sora) to create variations based on specific vehicles or setups.

real_qa.q: What operational change did Mariano implement to improve Google Ads performance compared to Meta?
real_qa.r: Mariano artificially restricts his Google Ads bot to make decisions only on specific days at set times (e.g., Wednesdays at 9 a.m.) after running deep analysis, rather than pushing buttons continuously throughout the day. Google Ads best practice is to set campaigns and let them run for a week before making adjustments, unlike Meta which benefits from more active day-to-day management. He also configured safety checks every 20 minutes that automatically turn off critically underperforming campaigns without waiting for his approval, even while he sleeps.
real_qa.requete: Google Ads bot management rules frequency

real_qa.q: How many monthly ad variations can Airlock now produce compared to before using AI automation?
real_qa.r: Before AI automation, Airlock's video editor could produce approximately five video batches per week. Now with AI agents orchestrating the entire creative pipeline, the limiting factor is no longer production capacity but strategic decision-making: whether Airlock should create 100 different video batch variations and whether they have sufficient ad spend budget to properly test them. The output quality is approximately 80 percent of hand-edited work but sufficient to provide directional data on what angles and styles convert.
real_qa.requete: Airlock video ad creative production increase AI

guest.bio_context: Mariano studied computer science at the University of Florida while working as a software engineer at Shopify on point of sale and mobile app development using React Native. He co-founded Airlock, which manufactures air purification and filtering systems for boats and RVs, initially as a side project with his business partner who identified the market need. After being laid off from Shopify during company-wide layoffs of 20-30%, he committed full-time to Airlock, dropping out of a master's degree in computer science after one year to focus on the business.

80 percent quality threshold: AI-generated video creative quality relative to hand-edited work
20 clicks per ad: Number of clicks required for each individual ad in the pre-automation workflow six months ago
$400-500 Grok credits in one day: Cost paid when Grok usage limits were reduced and the system hit rate limits
$300-400: Average price point of Airlock electronics (boats and RVs market segment)
90 to 180 days: Warranty extension for Black Friday campaign that the quality control bot caught in ad copy
